title: Instagram carousel — Premier IA low-time light jet
hook: Low time. Big cabin for the class. Fresh Check 3.
body:
Some light jets ask you to compromise. This 2005 Premier IA asks a lot less.

Around 2,835 hours total — genuinely low time for the type. Pro Line 21 with IFIS, TAP Blue engines, and a fresh Check 3, so the maintenance runway is open. And the Premier's cabin cross-section is one of the widest in the light-jet class, which you feel the moment you step in.

Capable, clean, and ready. Swipe through, then message us for the full spec.
cta: DM us for the full spec and status reports.
media_notes: Carousel order: exterior hero, cabin, cockpit. Keep to 3-5 strongest frames.
